hint.en: sandbox, deny rules, size of the enforced set

hint.zh: plan 模式、访谈、完成标准

practices.title: Clear context between unrelated tasks; do not let one session run on
practices.title_zh: 任务之间 /clear，会话不拖太长

sources.quote: /clear between unrelated tasks. It costs nothing…
sources.fragment: between unrelated tasks

sources.quote: after two failed corrections run /clear and write a better prompt instead of a third
sources.fragment: after two failed corrections run

sources.quote: Keep one chat per coherent unit of work.
sources.fragment: Keep one chat per coherent unit of work

practices.detect: Summary: sessions_over_200_tools, pct_compaction/correction over 200 tools vs overall, slash_cmds_sessions for clear/compact/new. ok = few long sessions and /clear or new sessions used; part = some long sessions; no = many long sessions with higher correction rate.

practices.title: Send verbose exploration to subagents so only a summary returns
practices.title_zh: 输出多的工作交给 subagent

sources.quote: the verbose output stays in the subagent's context while only a summary returns to your main conversation.
sources.fragment: the verbose output stays in the subagent

sources.quote: Delegate the exploration so only the findings come back.
sources.fragment: Delegate the exploration so only the findings come back

practices.detect: Summary: concepts_pct.subagent and agent_types_calls per host. ok = used in a meaningful share of sessions (roughly 20%+); part = rare; no = never.

practices.title: Define custom subagents and give simple ones a cheaper model
practices.title_zh: 自定义 subagent，简单任务用便宜模型

sources.quote: Set model: haiku in a subagent's definition if its work is simple
sources.fragment: if its work is simple

sources.quote: For simple subagent tasks, specify model: haiku in your subagent configuration.
sources.fragment: For simple subagent tasks

practices.detect: Config: claude[].custom_subagents and whether agent definitions set a model; summary: agent_types_calls (all general-purpose suggests none). na when the host has no subagent definitions.

practices.title: Tell /compact what to keep
practices.title_zh: /compact 时说明要保留的重点

sources.quote: /compact Focus on code samples and API usage tells Claude what to preserve during summarization.
sources.fragment: tells Claude what to preserve during summarization

practices.detect: Usually na: extract.py records the command name, not its arguments. ok if instruction files contain a 'Compact instructions' section.

practices.title: Use a lower-risk permission preset; pick reasoning effort per task
practices.title_zh: 用低风险权限预设，effort 按任务选

sources.quote: the lower-risk local automation preset is sandbox_mode = "workspace-write" together with approval_policy = "on-request"
sources.fragment: the lower-risk local automation preset is

sources.quote: Giving Codex full permission to your computer before you understand the workflow
sources.fragment: Giving Codex full permission to your computer

sources.quote: Low for faster, well-scoped tasks
sources.fragment: Low for faster, well-scoped tasks

sources.quote: Use danger-full-access only in a controlled environment
sources.fragment: only in a controlled environment

practices.detect: Config: codex[].approval_policy / sandbox_mode / model_reasoning_effort; summary: modes_sessions (approval=, sandbox=, yolo, bypassPermissions) and efforts for human sessions. no = full access with no approval in most human sessions; part = full access only in some.

practices.title: Enforce must-happen-every-time rules with hooks or deny rules
practices.title_zh: 必须每次执行的规则用 hook 强制

sources.quote: If something has to happen every time, make it a hook, a deny rule, or a managed setting.
sources.fragment: If something has to happen every time

practices.detect: Config: claude[].settings.json hook_entries and deny count. ok = at least one hook or deny rule enforcing a stated must-rule; no = none while instruction files contain 'always/never' rules.

practices.title: Keep the enforced set (hooks + deny rules) small
practices.title_zh: 强制规则（hook + deny）保持少量

sources.quote: Whatever the scope, keep the enforced set small. … If you ever find yourself at forty of them, most are probably preferences
sources.fragment: Whatever the scope, keep the enforced set small

practices.detect: Config: hook_entries + deny_count across settings files. ok < 20; part 20-39; no >= 40.

practices.title: Protect secret files with deny rules
practices.title_zh: 用 deny 规则保护密钥文件

sources.quote: deny rules hold in every permission mode, including auto and bypassPermissions, which is exactly why the .env rule belongs there
sources.fragment: rules hold in every permission mode

practices.detect: Config: settings deny_coverage flags env_files and ssh/aws/cloud_credentials/key_files. ok = env files and credential directories both covered; part = one; no = neither. Weigh by how often bypass/auto modes appear in modes_sessions.

practices.title: Keep AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md short
practices.title_zh: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 保持短小

sources.quote: A short, accurate AGENTS.md is more useful than a long file full of vague rules.
sources.fragment: is more useful than a long file full of vague rules

sources.quote: target under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file. Longer files consume more context and reduce adherence.
sources.fragment: target under 200 lines per

sources.quote: stops adding files once the combined size reaches the limit defined by project_doc_max_bytes (32 KiB by default)
sources.fragment: stops adding files once the combined size reaches the limit

practices.detect: Config: global_instructions / repo_instructions lines, bytes, over_200_lines, over_32KiB, and codex project_doc_max_bytes. no = any file read by Codex over 32 KiB; part = files over 200 lines; ok = all under.

practices.title: Put build, test and lint commands in the instruction file
practices.title_zh: 测试 / lint 命令写进 AGENTS.md

sources.quote: the single most useful line in your CLAUDE.md is the command that runs it.
sources.fragment: the single most useful line in your

sources.quote: Build, test, and lint commands
sources.fragment: Build, test, and lint commands

practices.detect: Config: repo_instructions[].mentions_test / mentions_lint for the most-used repositories. Global files are exempt (they belong to no repository).

practices.title: Update the rules when the same mistake happens twice
practices.title_zh: 同一错误出现两次就更新规则

sources.quote: When Codex makes the same mistake twice, ask it for a retrospective and update AGENTS.md.
sources.fragment: When Codex makes the same mistake twice

sources.quote: Start simple. Add rules only when you notice the agent making the same mistake repeatedly.
sources.fragment: Add rules only when you notice the agent making the same mistake repeatedly

practices.detect: Instruction files show rule maintenance (recent edits, rules tied to observed failures, an eval or review loop); compare corr_examples themes with existing rules. Judge from evidence; mark na if nothing can be seen.

practices.title: Move workflow-specific instructions into on-demand skills
practices.title_zh: 流程类内容放 skill，按需加载

sources.quote: Skills load on-demand only when invoked, so moving specialized instructions into skills keeps your base context smaller.
sources.fragment: load on-demand only when invoked

practices.detect: Config: claude[].skills count and over_500_lines; summary: concepts_pct.skill, top_skills. ok = skills exist and are used; part = long instruction files that hold workflows a skill could carry.

practices.title: Use plan mode before complex changes
practices.title_zh: 复杂改动先用 plan 模式

sources.quote: Claude reads files and proposes a plan but makes no edits until you approve.
sources.fragment: Claude reads files and proposes a plan but makes no edits until you approve

sources.quote: Plan mode lets Codex gather context, ask clarifying questions, and build a stronger plan before implementation.
sources.fragment: Plan mode lets Codex gather context

sources.quote: The most impactful change you can make is planning before coding.
sources.fragment: The most impactful change you can make is planning before coding

practices.detect: Summary: concepts_pct.plan_mode and modes_sessions containing 'plan'. part when plan mode is unused but planning substitutes (ask_user, planning skills) are common.

practices.title: Let the agent interview you when the request is vague
practices.title_zh: 需求模糊时让 agent 先访谈你

sources.quote: Ask Claude to interview you instead
sources.fragment: Ask Claude to interview you instead

practices.detect: Summary: concepts_pct.ask_user and interview-style skills in top_skills.

practices.title: State the done criteria in the prompt
practices.title_zh: 提示里写明完成标准（Done when）

sources.quote: Done when: What should be true before the task is complete, such as tests passing, behavior changing, or a bug no longer reproducing?
sources.fragment: What should be true before the task is complete

practices.detect: Usually na: needs semantic reading of prompts. Optional: sample ~20 first prompts (summary 'first' fields in the sessions file) and count those with an explicit completion condition; report the sample size.

practices.title: Give the agent runnable checks and ask for evidence
practices.title_zh: 给 agent 能跑的验证，并要证据

sources.quote: Give Claude something it can run that comes back pass or fail.
sources.fragment: Give Claude something it can run that comes back pass or fail

sources.quote: ask Claude for evidence: the command it ran and its output, or the screenshot.
sources.fragment: the command it ran and its output, or the screenshot

sources.quote: Ask it to create tests when needed, run the relevant checks, confirm the result, and review the work before you accept it.
sources.fragment: Ask it to create tests when needed, run the relevant checks

sources.quote: Tests allow the agent to make changes, evaluate results, and incrementally improve until it succeeds.
sources.fragment: Tests allow the agent to make changes

practices.detect: Summary: pct_session_bash_tags test/lint/typecheck/screenshot/git_diff per host; corr_examples about unverified work. ok = checks in most coding sessions and few 'not verified' corrections.

practices.title: When output is wrong, revert and rerun with a sharper plan instead of patching
practices.title_zh: 输出不对就回滚重来，不继续打补丁

sources.quote: Revert the changes, refine the plan to be more specific about what you need, and run it again.
sources.fragment: Revert the changes, refine the plan

practices.detect: Usually na: reverts happen through git, /rewind or manual edits with no single signal. Grok signals.json hasReverted is a partial hint.

practices.title: Isolate parallel work in separate git worktrees
practices.title_zh: 并行工作用 git worktree 隔离

sources.quote: When you have separate pieces of work going at once, give each its own checkout so the edits can't collide.
sources.fragment: give each its own checkout so the edits

sources.quote: Running live tasks on the same files without using Git worktrees
sources.fragment: Running live tasks on the same files without using Git worktrees

practices.detect: Summary: pct_session_bash_tags.worktree; cwd_top paths containing worktree directories or several clones of one repository.

practices.title: Run repeatable automation headless
practices.title_zh: 自动化任务用 headless 模式

sources.quote: runs once and exits, which is how Claude Code ends up in CI jobs, git hooks, and shell loops.
sources.fragment: runs once and exits

sources.quote: Run Claude non-interactively for CI, pre-commit hooks, or batch processing.
sources.fragment: Run Claude non-interactively for CI

practices.detect: Summary: headless.sessions and by_host; pct_session_bash_tags.headless.

practices.title: Cap headless runs with a turn or budget limit
practices.title_zh: 无头运行设轮数或花费上限

sources.quote: What stops it? --max-turns, --max-budget-usd, a spend limit.
sources.fragment: What stops it?

practices.detect: Wrapper scripts and scheduled jobs that start headless agents pass --max-turns / --max-budget-usd (or the host's equivalent). na when there are no headless sessions.
